notes: While it literally means 'pain of head', it is the standard way to say 'headache'.
It is also frequently used metaphorically to describe a difficult problem or an annoying situation, just like 'headache' in English.

senses.definition: A physical pain located in the head.

examples.text: Tengo un dolor de cabeza muy fuerte.
examples.translation: I have a very bad headache.
examples.emotion: wincing slightly while pressing a hand against the forehead

senses.definition: A frustrating, difficult, or annoying person or situation.
